summary.text: Jordan Lopez is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 112, which he has represented since 2025, and is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Lopez was born in Charlotte, North Carolina.
He received a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro and a master's in public administration from North Carolina Central University.
As of 2024, he was affiliated with CharlotteEAST, the Eastland Park stakeholder group, Charlotte-Mecklenburg's Get-Out-The-Vote Committee, and the Andrea Harris Task Force for Racial Equity.
He succeeded Tricia Cotham in the state House.
